package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	SubjectLearningActivityInteresting = "learning.activity.interesting"
	LearningActivitySchemaVersion      = 1
	InterventionPolicyVersion          = "teacher-intervention-policy-v1"
)

type LearningActivitySignal struct {
	EventID             string
	StudentID           string
	AnalyticsSessionID  string
	CourseID            string
	LessonID            string
	TaskID              string
	SignalType          string
	ConsecutiveFailures int
	SameErrorCount      int
	ActiveSeconds       int
	IdleSeconds         int
	Progressing         bool
	OccurredAt          time.Time
}

func NewLearningActivitySignal(input LearningActivitySignal) (LearningActivitySignal, error) {
	input.EventID = strings.TrimSpace(input.EventID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.AnalyticsSessionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.AnalyticsSessionID)
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.LessonID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LessonID)
	input.TaskID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskID)
	input.SignalType = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.SignalType))
	input.OccurredAt = input.OccurredAt.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	if !validUUID(input.EventID) || !validUUID(input.StudentID) || !validUUID(input.AnalyticsSessionID) ||
		!validUUID(input.CourseID) || !validUUID(input.LessonID) || !validUUID(input.TaskID) ||
		!validInterventionSignalType(input.SignalType) || input.ConsecutiveFailures < 0 || input.ConsecutiveFailures > 1000 ||
		input.SameErrorCount < 0 || input.SameErrorCount > 1000 || input.ActiveSeconds < 0 || input.ActiveSeconds > 86400 ||
		input.IdleSeconds < 0 || input.IdleSeconds > 86400 || input.OccurredAt.IsZero() {
		return LearningActivitySignal{}, errors.New("invalid learning activity signal")
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validInterventionSignalType(value string) bool {
	switch value {
	case "student_stuck", "student_idle", "repeated_failure", "progressing":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

type InterventionRecord struct {
	EventID            string
	StudentID          string
	AnalyticsSessionID string
	PersonalTeacherID  string
	DecisionID         string
	SignalType         string
	Action             TeacherAction
	OfferBody          string
	DialogID           string
	DialogMessageID    string
	CreatedAt          time.Time
	DeliveredAt        *time.Time
}
